text: Terraform ships as a single standalone binary. Bicep installs as a component of the Azure CLI. Let's get both running on your machine, plus the Azure CLI login both of them depend on.
Terraform needs no separate runtime. Install it through your package manager of choice, and confirm it landed on your PATH with terraform version.
Bicep isn't a separate download. Install the Azure CLI first, then run az bicep install. Check its version separately with az bicep version, since Bicep updates on its own release cadence.
Both tools reach Azure through the same Azure CLI login. Run az login, then az account show to confirm which subscription is active before you provision anything.
Terraform installed, Bicep installed, Azure CLI logged in. Next up: the provider block that tells Terraform which cloud it's actually talking to.
